legal.affiliateBody: Product links may be Amazon affiliate links. The price you pay does not change. No EuroMillions ticket sales. Not affiliated with FDJ or EuroMillions operators.
legal.adsense: No Google AdSense ads on EuroMillions Results for now.
legal.cookiesAdsBody: No Google AdSense on this site for now: no advertising cookies are set.
legal.privacyBody: We collect minimal technical data (server logs) and anonymised audience measurement via Umami (self-hosted, no advertising cookie). The contact form sends name, email and message only so we can reply. No resale of personal data. No AdSense for now.
legal.privacyConsent: No advertising cookies while AdSense is disabled. Strictly necessary cookies remain active. Technical measures: HTTPS, security headers, contact-form spam limits.
legal.privacyBasisBody: Legal bases: legitimate interest (security, technical logs, anonymised audience) and pre-contractual steps / responding to your request (contact form). Retention: technical logs for a limited period (a few weeks), contact messages for as long as needed to handle them, consent choice stored locally on your device until deleted.
